authority.projection: cpu_lhash_treesitter leaf extraction + declared pattern dimensions (candidate evidence, no mutation authority)
authority.status: PENDING_BUILD_HOST (Maven/OpenRewrite not executed on this host)

declared_rules.algorithm: NOT PROJECTED: requires M3PatternizeRecipe problem catalogues; keyword detectors are not admitted as algorithm identity
declared_rules.carrier: REGEX if Pattern.compile/matches/quote or String.replaceAll/replaceFirst/matches is invoked; else TEXT_BLOCK if a text_block literal occurs; else STRING if a string_literal occurs; else NONE
declared_rules.classes: leaves with fewer than 8 normalized tokens are not entered into pattern classes
declared_rules.complexity: normalized token count: <16 TRIVIAL, <64 SIMPLE, <256 ORDINARY, <1024 COMPLEX, <4096 HOSTILE, else PATHOLOGICAL
declared_rules.composition: LOCAL_ANON if a local class declaration or anonymous class body occurs; else LAMBDA_STREAM if a lambda, method reference or stream()/parallelStream() invocation occurs; else PLAIN
declared_rules.control: STRAIGHT: no control statement; NESTED: control nesting depth >= 2; SWITCH: a switch occurs at depth <= 1; BRANCH: otherwise
declared_rules.language: sorted '|'-joined flags among RECORD_GENERIC (record or type parameters), SEALED_PATTERN (sealed/non-sealed/permits, instanceof type/record pattern, switch pattern label), METHOD_REFERENCE, TRY_RESOURCE, RECURSIVE (unqualified or this-qualified self invocation); BASELINE when none
declared_rules.native: DECLARATION if the native modifier is present; OVERLOAD if another method of the same owner shares the name; else NONE
declared_rules.visibility: modifier keyword public/protected/private, else package (interface-implicit public is not inferred)
